nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the contract owner, set once in the constructor.
Public uint state variable tracking the last completed migration index.
Constructor that initialises owner with the deploying account.
External restricted function that writes the supplied completed value into last_completed_migration.
External restricted function that casts newAddress to a Migrations instance and calls setCompleted on it with the stored migration index.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and the restricted modifier access check.
Caller-supplied uint argument written into the last_completed_migration state variable.
Caller-supplied address argument used to construct a Migrations instance for the external call.
Local Migrations reference created from the untrusted newAddress parameter and used as the external call target.
External call to upgraded.setCompleted(last_completed_migration) executed on an address fully controlled by the caller.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns the owner state variable directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
The restricted modifier gates setCompleted on the comparison msg.sender == owner.
The restricted modifier gates upgrade on the comparison msg.sender == owner.
The completed parameter flows into the last_completed_migration state variable.
The newAddress parameter is used to instantiate the local upgraded Migrations reference.
The local upgraded reference is the receiver of the external setCompleted call.
Execution of upgrade reaches the outbound external call on the caller-supplied contract.
The last_completed_migration state variable value is passed as the argument of the external call.
The external call on upgraded executes setCompleted on the target contract, giving the callee control flow before upgrade returns.

normalization_plan.reason: The completed parameter is a non-core node whose only role is to supply the value written by the setCompleted function.
The newAddress parameter is a non-core node consumed exclusively by the upgrade function to build the call target.
The upgraded local variable is a non-core node that exists solely as the receiver of the external setCompleted call.
